name: sideclip
description: Open the Sideclip picker and insert the chosen clip, or insert a recent screenshot file path.

interface.shortDescription: Sideclip picker or a recent screenshot path
interface.longDescription: Opens the Sideclip clipboard picker and inserts the chosen clip into the chat. For screenshot files, lists the newest paths in Pictures\Screenshots as text (no image ingest).
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Sideclip picker and insert what I pick.
